traits.rosette.note: Flora of China (Plantago major): leaves basal; petiole 1-10(-26) cm; blade broadly ovate to broadly elliptic, 3-18(-30) x 2-11(-21) cm, veins (3 or)5 or 7, base cuneate, subrounded or cordate, +- decurrent onto petiole, margin remotely dentate to subentire, apex acute to obtuse. Spikes narrowly cylindric, 1-20(-40) cm; peduncle 2-18(-45) cm. Corolla white; anthers purplish or white. Fl. Jun-Aug.
